cited.quote: Formation of a new separate Commissionerate of Textiles along with posts
The newly created Commisionerate of Textiles will commence its function from 25.10.2021

rationale: C5 (G.O.(Ms) No.112, 22.10.2021) forms a separate Commissionerate of Textiles to focus on the textile sector, which is the closest official equivalent of a textile development commission. The name and form differ somewhat from the promise, so some doubt remains.

cited.quote: TNRDC was formed as Joint Venture of 50:50 shareholding of TIDCO and IL&FS Private Company

rationale: C1 describes TNRDC and its functions, but no extract shows any order to appoint 75,000 road workers or to reserve 30,000 seats for women. C4 and C5 are unrelated sanctions.

cited.quote: minorities – 16%, Persons with Disability (PWD) – 3% and women (combining all categories)

rationale: C1 (ITI upgrades), C2 (central DDU-GKY with a 3% PWD quota) and C3 (minority loans) are general or other-group schemes. None gives PWD-specific ITI skilling plus subsidised self-employment loans.

cited.quote: a monthly financial assistance of Rs.3,000/- is sanctioned to the yesteryear national medallists

rationale: C3 shows only the existing 1978 pension scheme for indigent sportspersons, a needs-based scheme that predates this government. No extract shows a new pension on retirement for medal-winning sportspersons.

cited.quote: Adequate safety of employment of women under section 44
Provide safe, secure and healthy working condition such that no women employee is disadvantaged in connection with her employment

rationale: C1 and C2 are the preliminary (draft) notification of state rules under G.O.(Ms) No.38 (2022-04-11), with a chapter on women's safety conditions. A preliminary notification is only a preparatory step, not final guidelines, and is part of a broad code rather than a dedicated measure.

cited.quote: Exclusive website has been created for Women Helpline and it is enabled to provide

rationale: C1 and C3 describe the general Women Helpline (181) and One Stop Centres, which are not specific to workplace safety. C4 is a draft policy and its task force is for schools. No workplace-specific task force or helpline is shown.

cited.quote: 4,000 home herbal gardens will be promoted with a financial outlay of Rs.1 crore

rationale: C1 is a budget plan for home herbal gardens, a different object. No extract mentions the Kavalur herbal garden in Vellore or an order to reopen it.

cited.quote: the employer of the establishment shall forthwith inform by telephone or special messenger or electronically

rationale: C1 and C5 (draft OSH rules) only prescribe notice of accidents, and C2 concerns wage deductions. C3 covers delayed MGNREGS wages and C4 wildlife damage. None provides compensation for employment injury or property damage.

cited.quote: 8 titles have been planned for the second phase of translation which includes Tamizh Nattil Gandhi,

rationale: C2 reports Tamil works already translated into English and a second phase only planned, with no GO or launch date. There is no Tamil translation of world classics. C1 only describes an old publication-assistance scheme.

cited.quote: Inclusion of additional areas in Tiruthani Local Planning Area

rationale: C5 is a planning-area notification for Tiruthani, not a bus station or accommodation facility. C4 covers rural bus stand facilities in general, and C1 and C2 are not about new bus stations at the named places.

cited.quote: subject to a maximum of 18,000 litres per boat per year

rationale: C1 (policy note, 2021-22) shows the diesel entitlement for mechanised boats at the old level of 18,000 litres per boat per year and says the scheme continues. No extract shows an increase to 2,000 litres or the equivalent.

cited.quote: This Board is recruiting personnel for the following posts

rationale: C1 only describes the existing Uniformed Services Recruitment Board and its recruitment mandate. C3 to C5 are IPS transfers. No extract shows an order or schedule to fill police vacancies annually.

cited.quote: involving buses of State Transport Undertaking or private operators registered in this State

rationale: C3 shows the Chief Minister's Accident Relief Fund from 1978, which is old and is not medical insurance. C2 and C4 are the New Health Insurance Scheme 2021, which covers accidents generally but not bus accidents specifically. Not matched to the promise.

cited.quote: this Government has decided to reduce the effective rate of tax on petrol by Rs.3 per litre

rationale: C3 is a budget speech announcing a Rs.3 per litre petrol tax cut, which is only an announcement and covers neither Rs.5 on petrol nor any diesel cut. No GO or law is shown in the other extracts.

cited.quote: Conducting Coaching Classes for Competitive Examinations through separate Channel for Education of Kalvi Television

rationale: C3 and C5 sanction TV coaching for TNPSC, SSC, RRB and UPSC-type exams, and C1 covers civil services coaching. None is coaching for IIT, NIT, AIIMS or IIM entrance in district headquarters, so the exams and mode differ.

No extract mentions urging the Union government for a Crisis Management Centre for conflict resolution. C1 is a cyber crisis plan, and C2 to C5 concern governance, juvenile justice, land systems and NITI Aayog districts.

cited.quote: A special drive has been initiated under the guidance of
sale deeds will be issued for 25,000 families living in the tenements/plots after verifying authenticity of the beneficiaries

rationale: C2 reports a special drive for TNHB sale deeds, with no GO or date. C1 and C3 give a 2021-22 plan to issue 25,000 sale deeds after verification at TNSCB. Hire purchase is not mentioned and the drive's dates and results are not shown, so it is not shown as operational.

No extract is about a Thanjavur-Orathanadu-Pattukottai broad gauge rail line. C1 lists village panchayats, C2 a river bridge, C3 sports facilities, C4 a budget speech on buses and metro, and C5 Chennai Metro.

No extract shows any effort to move education from the Concurrent List to the State List. C1 urges constitutional amendments on reservation and census, which is a different subject. C4 only describes lawmaking under the two lists in general.

cited.quote: This scheme is being implemented in the State since 2017-18
decided to implement the Price Support Scheme (PSS) for procurement of Copra in Tamil Nadu

rationale: C1, C3 and C4 give the 2022 season notification of the existing NAFED Price Support Scheme through the Agricultural Marketing Board. C5 says it has run since 2017-18, so this is the same activity continuing with no new step. The Coconut Welfare Board is not mentioned.
